renderscale.name: RenderScale
text.autoconfig.renderscale.title: RenderScale Options
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.scale: Relative to your current window resolution.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.targe: Dynamic Scale will try to aim for this FPS. Keep this value below your max framerate! Set to 0 to disable.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.aggre: How quickly resolution changes (Note: Resolution only changes when the camera moves!).
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.minim: The lowest scale that will be set.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsr.@: Results vary depending on your hardware. Compare your FPS! Only enables at 100% scale and below
Results vary depending on your hardware, compare your FPS!
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.downs: Auto uses the best sampler for your scale. You can override it if you want.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.sharp: Simply sharpens the resulting image. It's up to you!
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.force: Forces bilinear upscaling on scale factors less than 100%.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.irisS: The scale factor when shaders are enabled.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.category.dyn: Dynamic scaling is unavailable while shaders are enabled due to issues with stuttering.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.aggre: How quickly resolution changes (Note: Resolution only changes when the camera moves!).
